skill.name: website-to-hyperframes
skill.description: Capture a public website, extract its visual assets, and guide Claude or Claude Code through creating a HyperFrames video project.
skill.summary: Turns a website capture into a storyboarded HyperFrames video workflow.
skill.author: heygen-com

security_audit.summary: The skill performs a legitimate website-to-video workflow, but it requires external CLI execution, website capture, local artifact creation, and optional API key handling. Most static shell and reconnaissance hits are markdown false positives, while capture artifacts, repo-root .env guidance, relative asset paths, and npm validation commands remain real risks that require user awareness.

remediation.issue: Optional API keys are documented for a repo-root .env file.
remediation.suggestion: Recommend a project-local ignored secrets file or environment variables set outside the repository, and warn users never to commit API keys.

remediation.issue: Website capture stores screenshots, extracted text, assets, and generated agent files on disk.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to capture only public or authorized websites and to review capture artifacts before sharing or publishing the generated video project.

remediation.issue: The workflow depends on npx hyperframes commands and local validation in headless Chrome.
remediation.suggestion: Document the commands plainly and require user confirmation before running capture, lint, validate, preview, snapshot, or render commands.
Keep all generated project files inside a dedicated project directory and avoid accepting untrusted user-controlled path names for asset references.

content.value_statement: Teams need fast ways to convert an existing website into a polished video concept. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through capture, design analysis, scripting, storyboarding, composition, validation, and delivery.
actual_capabilities: Captures a website into screenshots, extracted text, design tokens, fonts, and assets using HyperFrames capture.
Creates DESIGN.md, SCRIPT.md, and STORYBOARD.md artifacts that gate the video production workflow.
Guides beat-by-beat HyperFrames composition work using captured assets and motion design techniques.
Maps narration and transcript timing into storyboard beats for synchronized scenes.
Runs HyperFrames lint, validate, snapshot, and preview steps before delivery.
Delivers a local HyperFrames Studio project URL before optional MP4 rendering.
limitations: Requires HyperFrames tooling and npm commands to be available in the working environment.
Captures and stores website content locally, so private or restricted sites need explicit permission.
Does not automatically render MP4 output unless the user explicitly asks for export.
Generated video quality depends on the captured website assets and the clarity of the user request.

use_cases.title: Product launch video
use_cases.description: Turn a product website into a short launch video with captured brand assets, narration, and animated scenes.

use_cases.title: Website-based social ad
use_cases.description: Create a concise vertical or square ad from a landing page for social media testing.

use_cases.title: Product tour draft
use_cases.description: Use screenshots, visible text, and assets from a website to draft a guided product tour in HyperFrames.

prompt_templates.title: Create a simple website video
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with one public URL.
prompt_templates.prompt: Capture this public website and create a 20-second HyperFrames product video: [URL]. Use the site colors, fonts, and main hero assets.

prompt_templates.title: Make a social ad from a landing page
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn [URL] into a 15-second vertical social ad. Emphasize the main value proposition, use fast but readable motion, and stop at the preview URL.

prompt_templates.title: Build a narrated product tour
prompt_templates.scenario: Longer video with narration and timing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 45-second narrated product tour from [URL]. Write the script, generate beat timing, build the HyperFrames compositions, validate them, and show me the Studio preview.

prompt_templates.title: Create a polished launch reel
prompt_templates.prompt: Capture [URL] and produce a cinematic launch reel for technical buyers. Use the captured assets, include kinetic typography, validate every beat with snapshots, and render only after I approve the preview.

output_examples.input: Capture a SaaS landing page and make a 25-second launch video.
output: A site summary with colors, fonts, sections, key assets, and visual vibe.
Generated design, script, and storyboard documents for the video.
A validated HyperFrames Studio preview URL for review.

output_examples.input: Create a short social ad from a marketing homepage.
output: A concise ad script with beat timing.
Compositions using captured screenshots, logos, and typography.
Snapshot checks showing each major scene before final handoff.

best_practices: Use only public or authorized websites, and review captured artifacts before sharing output.
Approve the local Studio preview before requesting an MP4 render.
Keep each video project in its own directory so capture assets and generated files stay isolated.
anti_patterns: Do not capture private dashboards, authenticated pages, or customer data without explicit authorization.
Do not paste raw SVG, image, or font file contents into prompts when file paths are enough.
Do not render final MP4 files before reviewing snapshots and the Studio preview.

faq.question: Does this skill need API keys?
faq.answer: No API keys are required for basic capture. Optional Gemini or Google keys can improve image descriptions, but they must be handled securely.

faq.question: Can it work with any website?
faq.answer: It is intended for public or authorized websites. Sites behind login, paywalls, or legal restrictions need explicit permission and careful handling.

faq.question: Does it automatically create an MP4?
faq.answer: No. The workflow delivers a local HyperFrames Studio preview first and renders MP4 only after the user explicitly asks.

faq.question: What files does it create?
faq.answer: It creates capture artifacts, design notes, scripts, storyboards, compositions, snapshots, and optional render files inside a project directory.

faq.question: Can Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code when the HyperFrames tooling is available.

faq.question: What should users review before publishing?
faq.answer: Users should review captured screenshots, extracted text, referenced assets, preview scenes, and any generated narration for accuracy and rights clearance.
